Geothermal vent failed to reach superheated eruption thermodynamic profile
triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: In ColonyGeothermalSystem::Update(), when phase timer crossed PreEruptionDurationSec, the phase switch transitioned vent.m_Phase to Erupting without immediately initializing the peak thermodynamic state variables (temperature 350C, pressure 1200 kPa, steam output 25 kg/s). Because the switch block had already completed for that update tick, callers interrogating the vent within the same frame saw PreEruption residual values until the subsequent tick.

Minimal Repair:
1. Initialize eruption thermodynamics immediately upon state transition inside the timer boundary.
2. Similarly initialize baseline dormant thermodynamics immediately when transitioning out of cooling.
